d: At Rotana, we are passionate about creating Treasured Time for our guests and colleagues through genuine hospitality, strong leadership and operational excellence.

We are looking for an experienced and commercially driven Cluster General Manager to provide strategic and operational leadership across Centro Waha, Centro Shaheen and Rotana Corniche, with the position based in Riyadh.

This is a key leadership role responsible for driving the overall performance of the three properties, strengthening their market positioning and ensuring consistent delivery of Rotana's operational, financial and service standards. The successful candidate will lead the hotel management teams while building a strong performance culture focused on our guests, colleagues and business results. This positioning is aligned with the leadership competencies used in Rotana's senior operational roles.
q: Bachelor's degree in Hospitality Management, Business Administration or a related field.
Significant senior leadership experience within the international hospitality industry, ideally as a General Manager or Cluster General Manager.
Strong multi-property operational and commercial leadership experience.
Proven track record in delivering financial performance, operational excellence and high levels of guest satisfaction.
Strong understanding of the Saudi Arabian hospitality market and previous experience in Saudi Arabia or the wider Middle East would be highly preferred.
Excellent leadership, strategic planning, financial and stakeholder-management capabilities.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills with fluency in English; Arabic would be an advantage.
A hands-on, commercially astute and results-driven leadership style, with the ability to inspire diverse teams and successfully manage multiple properties.
The competency profile is aligned with Rotana's existing senior management framework: Understanding the Business, Influencing Outcomes, Planning for Business, Team Building, Valuin
